description: This file provides utility functions and dependencies for verifying and extracting information from Supabase JWT tokens within a FastAPI application. It includes functions for fetching JWKS, verifying token signatures, and extracting user claims, as well as a FastAPI dependency for authenticated routes.

methods.name: get_supabase_url
methods.description: Retrieves the SUPABASE_URL environment variable or raises an error if missing.

methods.name: _jwks_url
methods.description: Constructs the URL to fetch JWKS from Supabase based on the environment variable.

methods.name: _get_cached_jwks
methods.description: Retrieves cached JWKS data if available and not expired.

methods.name: _set_cached_jwks
methods.description: Caches JWKS data with a TTL.

methods.name: _fetch_jwks
methods.description: Fetches JWKS from Supabase and caches the result.

methods.name: _get_kid
methods.description: Extracts the 'kid' from a JWT header without verification.

methods.name: _find_jwk_for_kid
methods.description: Finds the JWK in JWKS matching the given 'kid'.

methods.name: _expected_issuers
methods.description: Returns the list of acceptable issuer URLs for Supabase tokens.

methods.name: verify_jwt
methods.description: Verifies a JWT token's signature and claims, returning the decoded claims if valid.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: FastAPI dependency that extracts and verifies the JWT from the Authorization header, returning user claims.
